name: EoB-BBOB benchmark synthesis
description: Write a Python objective(X) function defining a deterministic, vectorised minimisation problem on [-5, 5]^10; scored by sqrt(LSI x min(1, ADC / 0.5)), combining landscape-feature similarity to the 24 BBOB functions with the spread of mean results of ten local optimisers (10 runs of 5,000 evaluations each; higher is better).

sources.locator: BBOB noiseless function definitions (Hansen et al., 2009) used for the 24 anchor functions of the landscape-similarity score

requirements.hardware: See upstream requirements and task notes.

evaluation.paper_metric: landscape similarity and algorithm distinction capability

commands.notes: EoB-BBOB benchmark-function search. Model-driven search: requires LLM API credentials and incurs cost; never run by seed checks.

Set api_key and model in config.py
